versions.changelog: feat: add local OCR support for scanned PDFs and .doc file format

Major improvements: Achieved 100% sync success rate (595/595 files). Added vision model support (Gemini/OpenAI) for scanned PDFs, increased file size limit to 1000MB, extended timeouts to 600s. Multi-modal processing automatically detects empty PDF content and uses Vision API as fallback.

Major improvements: Success rate increased from ~40% to 95%. Added XML extraction fallback for corrupted xlsx files, increased file size limit to 100MB, extended timeouts to 300s, multi-encoding support for text files.
Add incremental sync, scheduled sync, and progress display features
Clarify database type - Khoj uses embedded PostgreSQL (not SQLite)
Switch to SQLite mode for lower memory usage

local-ai-search 1.0.0 - Initial release

- Provides natural language search for local files (200GB+), triggered by user requests about searching local/computer/folder content.
- Supports searching xlsx, pptx, pdf, docx, and md formats with location info (sheet name, slide number, etc.).
- Integrates with Khoj as the RAG backend; uses MarkItDown for Office-to-Markdown conversion.
- No local LLM required; relies on cloud API (OpenAI/DeepSeek/Claude).
- Returns matched file name, content snippet, and specific location in the document.
- Designed for resource-limited hardware with simple CLI commands and web UI.
